crossRefs.note: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior…
Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.
This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.
It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahweh.
Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.
Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at…
Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.
I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.
This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound…
But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.

translations.web: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.
translations.bsb: But I will always hope and will praise You more and more.
translations.kjv: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.
translations.asv: But I will hope continually, And will praise thee yet more and more.
